Job Profile Summary:

The Senior Tax Accountant, working under limited supervision, carries the valuation and negotiation work for Devon's largest ad valorem jurisdictions. The role is accountable for the value Devon argues and the number Devon forecasts: it holds the technical position on assigned counties and states, deals directly with appraisal districts and Appraisal Review Boards, and is the person who explains to operations and accounting why the ad valorem tax number moved. Judgment rests with the role on valuation methodology, obsolescence and what a value is worth contesting; negotiated assessments are presented to leadership to be bound. This is a specialist valuation and forecasting position.

Job Description:

• Analyzes expense, pricing and production for Texas proved developed producing properties, develops net present value using decline curve modeling, and tests the appraisal district's decline, pricing, operating cost and remaining-life assumptions to build the counter-position.

• Applies economic and functional obsolescence and the three approaches to value for marketing and midstream assets, and defends those positions with appraisal districts.

• Builds the annual ad valorem tax budget and forecast off the valuation model in the first month of the fiscal year, reforecasts as each month's pricing, operating cost and production actuals land, and prepares the information accruals and regulatory initiatives draw on.

• Explains plan-to-actual and period-over-period variance to operations and accounting by driver, including where the appraisal district's forward price deck departs from Devon's trailing twelve-month realizations.

• Holds area of responsibility for assigned counties and states ad valorem taxes and prepares the most complex renditions.

• Implements tax planning techniques that minimize ad valorem tax, using relevant statutes, court decisions and local custom and practice.

• Maintains the integrity of the rendition population across the assigned portfolio, with new wells and facilities added, disposed assets removed and ownership changes recorded.

• Negotiates ad valorem tax assessments independently with state and local taxing authorities and presents cases to leadership for binding assessments.

• Prepares and defends exemption and abatement applications, including pollution control, freeport and negotiated agreements.

• Represents Devon at formal Appraisal Review Board hearings with prepared evidence and testimony.

• Represents Devon in industry groups, government affairs and community outreach on ad valorem matters.

Education:

• A Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or any other related discipline is preferred but not required.

• A minimum of 12 academic hours in accounting or finance is required, whether or not a degree is held.

• Candidates without a Bachelor's Degree must have a minimum of 8 years of appraisal experience in an upstream oil and gas ad valorem tax career in place of the degree.

Experience:

• 5+ years of relevant experience, preferably in areas such as accounting, banking, finance, property valuation, or a related field, with exposure to budgeting, forecasting, or financial modeling.

• Experience with ad valorem tax management software, discounted cash flow and reservoir-curve valuation/analysis, and appraisal district negotiation is preferred.

• Upstream oil and gas industry experience within accounting, land, operations, or tax is preferred.

Certifications:

• Certified Member of the Institute - Ad Valorem Tax (CMI-AVT), CPA or CFA (preferred).

• Two ad valorem tax courses totaling 80+ hours through IPT, COST, or combination (preferred).

Competencies: • Active Learning • Business Acumen • Coaching & Development • Digital Literacy • Influence • Innovation • Oral & Written Communication • Problem Solving • Results Oriented • Stakeholder Relationships

Skills: • Account Reconciliations • Ad Valorem Tax Management Software • Appraisal Review Board Advocacy • Assessment Negotiation • Budgeting & Forecasting • Business Process Improvements • Data Analysis & Reporting • Decline Curve Analysis • Discounted Cash Flow Modeling • Documentation Procedures • Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) • Obsolescence Analysis • Property Valuation • Tax Accounting • Tax Rendition Compliance • Variance Analysis

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

As Scale AI continues its historic growth trajectory in Generative AI, we are seeking a Growth Strategy & Operations Lead to help ensure our customer projects have the expert capacity they need to deliver on time. jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

What We Do

Product Management partners with game development, publishing, marketing, and platform teams to provide a data and market-driven view of product strategy that aligns with business goals. As part of Epic’s Growth Team, we use our product expertise to identify and drive growth levers to grow our player base and business.

TECHNICAL PRODUCT MANAGEMENT INTERN

What You'll Do

We are building the Discover Publish Tool to help our creators and partners manage and publish their content. As a Technical Product Management Intern, you will help define and ship improvements to this tooling and get hands-on experience taking a product idea from problem definition through delivery. You'll work closely with engineers, the product lead, and the operators who use the tool every day to understand problems, write clear requirements, make scope tradeoffs, and test what gets built. Along the way, you'll learn from an experienced product manager and gain hands-on experience with the tools, processes, and practices used to build high-quality products. By the end of the internship, you'll have shipped a real product improvement that our partners use.

In this role, you will

• Define scoped product improvements for Discover by writing clear requirements, user flows, and acceptance criteria with guidance from the product lead
• Take a scoped product improvement from problem definition through build, testing, and delivery, with support from an experienced product mentor
• Talk to the operators and partners who use our solutions to understand their workflows and turn pain points into actionable requirements
• Use data such as usage metrics, dashboards, and spreadsheet or SQL analysis to size problems, inform prioritization, and measure whether shipped features work
• Test features before release, give structured feedback to engineers, and help coordinate and communicate releases to stakeholders
• Learn and apply team product practices, tools, and processes

What we're looking for

• Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a degree program in Business, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
• Demonstrated technical aptitude: comfort working with data (spreadsheets, SQL, or similar), a working understanding of how web applications, APIs, and databases fit together, and the curiosity to get hands-on with new technical tools (light coding or scripting experience is a plus, not a requirement)
• Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear, structured documents
• Foundational problem-solving skills, with an ability to learn quickly and work collaboratively
• Interest in owning problems end to end and building high-quality tools and user experiences for creators and partners
• Ability to receive and incorporate feedback and work effectively with guidance from experienced team members

This internship has a flexible start date in 2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit epicgames.com/earlycareers. This is going to be Epic!

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. ABOUT THE TEAM

The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of Digital Native customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.

You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.

You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.

- Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.

- Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.

- Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.

- Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.

- Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.

- Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.

- Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.

- Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.

- Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.

- Apply Digital Native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.

- Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.

- Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.

- Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.

- Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.

- Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.

- Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.

- Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.

- Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.

- Bring meaningful experience with digital-native businesses or strong fluency with the needs of technology companies.

- Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.

- Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
